name: system-identification-from-responses
description: Identify a system's transfer function, state dynamics, and constraint boundaries from measured input-output response data using classical system identification methods and least-squares estimation.

config.instruction: Clean the raw measurements: resample to a common time base, remove outliers, interpolate short gaps, segment into steady-state and transient regions, compute effective bandwidth.
Test linearity, estimate system order from SVD, estimate delay from cross-correlation. Rank candidate model structures from simplest to most complex.
Fit parameters for each candidate structure using least-squares or subspace methods. Compute fit percentage, AIC, and analyze residual whiteness.
Predict on held-out data. Cross-validate across operating regions. Select the model with best validation accuracy at lowest complexity.
Map saturation, rate limits, conditional gates, and fault boundaries from the data. Define the safe operating envelope where the model is valid.
